title: Skill Master - Agent Skills Management
description: Access and leverage agent skills library. Skills are instruction-based guides that teach agents how to perform specialized tasks like document editing, MCP development, testing, and visual design.
whenToUse: Learning how to perform a new task
Finding the right skill for a specialized capability
Creating or editing documents (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf)
Creating visual designs or algorithmic art
instructions: 1) Use skill_list to see all available skills when starting a new task.
2) Use skill_search to find skills matching a capability (e.g., 'document', 'testing', 'design').
3) Use skill_get to load full skill instructions before attempting a task.
4) Use skill_file to access templates, scripts, or reference files within a skill.
5) Follow skill instructions step-by-step for best results.
6) Store learned patterns and outcomes in cipher-memory for future reference.
7) Skills are instructions, not code - read and follow them like a guide.

skillSources.anthropics: Official Anthropic skills (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, mcp-builder)
skillSources.huggingface: HuggingFace ML skills (model training, datasets, evaluation)
skillSources.skillcreator: SkillCreator.ai collection (40+ development, business, integration skills)

gateway.description: Skills accessed via unified MCP Gateway
